description: Known regression cases for first-pass coverage and unsupported-finding checks. Keep expectations outside the replay checkout.

cases.head: 2ba39d63f6287be988328f521b8fbbc08403098a
expected_findings: Unchanged screenshot generator builds removed package name
Ignored benchmark doc command selects removed package name
Startup termination can bypass temporary bundle/converter cleanup
Running child is orphaned on direct HUP/QUIT to wrapper
Assertion-failure test cleanup can orphan its child

unsupported_claims: A single 1024-pixel iconset entry necessarily makes iconutil conversion fail
subprocess.run leaves its blocked child running when SystemExit unwinds it
Popen.send_signal exposes ProcessLookupError when a POSIX child has already exited
evidence: Native iconutil conversion with only icon_512x512@2x.png succeeded and actual Cargo launch reported NSRunningApplication.localizedName Euphoria.
Python 3.12.12 subprocess.run kills the child on BaseException and Popen.__exit__ reaps it. Blocked-converter startup tests pass for INT, TERM, HUP and QUIT.
Python 3.12.12 Popen.send_signal polls and suppresses ProcessLookupError around os.kill.
